## Description

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is seeking an experienced Procurement Center of Excellence Manager to join our Global Supply Chain Team. In this role, you will enable Procurement best practices through process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives. You will develop strategic business partnership relationships and execute comprehensive strategies to support business growth and deliver operational excellence.

#### Responsibilities:

- Partner with Global Supply Management (GSM) and cross-functional stakeholders to embed procurement standards into tooling and operational workflows
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging technology, insights, and leading best practices to enhance procurement effectiveness and user experience
- Operationalize policies through smart automation; designing intuitive workflows that reduce friction and maintain compliance
- Lead training and change management efforts for cross functional stakeholders; using customer insights to drive change management
- Maintain documentation for procurement workflows and best practices across the organization
- Serve as an advisor and partner to the business, providing subject matter expertise on procurement policies, training, and compliance requirements
- Implement supplier relationship management (SRM) programs and KPIs to drive optimal performance and risk mitigation
- Lead the end-to-end development and enhancement of procurement workflows; leveraging AI and automation to guide end users through intuitiveness design
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization
- Strong analytical and ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously
- Support mergers, acquisitions, and business expansion activities through Sourcing Expertise

#### Experience:

- A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is typically required.
  - Relevant certifications (e.g., CSCP, CPM) may be advantageous.
- Experience with procurement technology platforms (e.g., Oracle, Zip), advanced analytics tools, and Google Workspace
- 3 to 5+ years of experience in procurement or strategic sourcing, preferred

#### Benefits:

- Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
- Mental health benefits
- Family building benefits
- Child care and pet benefits
- 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
- In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
- Subsidized commuter benefits
- Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership
